root_cause_components_logs = ["apache01", "apache02", "Tomcat01", "Tomcat02", "Tomcat03", "Tomcat04"]

# Define failure time window in UTC+8 timezone
tz = pytz.timezone('Asia/Shanghai')
start_time = pd.Timestamp('2021-03-06 06:00:00', tz=tz)
end_time = pd.Timestamp('2021-03-06 06:30:00', tz=tz)

if not log_df.empty:
    # Convert timestamp to datetime with UTC+8 timezone
    log_df['datetime'] = pd.to_datetime(log_df['timestamp'], unit='s').dt.tz_localize('UTC').dt.tz_convert(tz)

    # Filter logs by components and failure time window
    filtered_logs = log_df[
        (log_df['cmdb_id'].isin(root_cause_components_logs)) &
        (log_df['datetime'] >= start_time) &
        (log_df['datetime'] <= end_time)
    ]

    # Summarize logs by component and log_name: count and sample messages (up to 3 samples)
    summary_logs = filtered_logs.groupby(['cmdb_id', 'log_name']).agg(
        log_count=('log_id', 'size'),
        sample_messages=('value', lambda x: x.head(3).tolist())
    ).reset_index()
else:
